about.meta_description: Learn about Grand Harvest Precision's history, philosophy, factory scale, and milestones.
about.page_title: A reliable manufacturing partner with steady growth
about.page_description: Founded in 1986, Grand Harvest Precision started from traditional metal processing and gradually expanded into precision stamping, automated inspection, and tooling development.
about.hero_image_note: Suggested: company exterior, founder portrait, or factory entrance
about.history_description: The company began with stamping and tooling repair services, then expanded into precision tooling, high-speed stamping lines, and standardized quality management.
about.philosophy_description: We build partnerships through integrity, sustain trust through quality, and strengthen resilience through continuous improvement and sustainable manufacturing.
about.factory_description: We operate two production sites with a total area of about 8,000 square meters and more than 120 professionals across tooling, process engineering, QA, and technical sales support.
about.factory_image_note: Suggested: shopfloor, reception area, or office environment
about.team_image_note: Suggested: management team or on-site operations photo
about.timeline_1_description: Company founded, focusing on metal stamping and tooling repair services.
about.timeline_2_description: Introduced ISO 9001 quality management and standardized production workflows.
about.timeline_3_description: Expanded with a second plant, adding high-speed presses and automatic feeding lines.
about.timeline_4_description: Upgraded optical inspection equipment and introduced smart manufacturing management.
about.timeline_5_description: Enhanced low-carbon materials and green process planning for sustainable production.

products.meta_description: Explore product categories, specifications, applications, and custom manufacturing capabilities.
products.page_description: We provide both standard mass production and project-based development to support a smooth transition from samples to volume manufacturing.
products.hero_image_note: Suggested: product collage, terminal close-up, or tooling photo
products.product_1_description: Materials include copper alloys, stainless steel, nickel plating, and tin plating for small and precise components.
products.product_1_application: Applications: consumer electronics, communication equipment, industrial control
products.product_2_description: We provide progressive dies, single-operation dies, and fixtures according to part complexity and trial plans.
products.product_2_application: Applications: automotive electronics, medical devices, aerospace peripherals
products.product_3_description: Supports material thickness from 0.1 mm to 3.0 mm, with tolerance control down to ±0.01 mm depending on drawings.
products.product_3_application: Applications: machinery, energy modules, industrial components
products.spec_description: We support different metals, thicknesses, tolerances, and surface treatments, with drawing review and pilot-run suggestions for manufacturability and cost efficiency.
products.custom_description: OEM / ODM projects are supported from material suggestion and tooling design to sampling, validation, and mass production inspection.
